title: Figure 7: Lightcraft nanosatellite concept schematic
description: Line drawing of an axisymmetric Lightcraft body with labeled parts: "Shroud (Cowl)", "Forebody: for Lift and Compression of Airflow during Atmospheric Flight", "Afterbody: with Mirrored Surface for Focusing Laser Energy into the Shroud (Cowl)" and "Axi-Symmetric Body". An incoming "Laser Beam" is shown, with notes on laser airbreathing flight to hypersonic speed and laser rocket flight to orbital speed. Caption: "Figure 7. Lightcraft Concept [26]."
